reviews.title: Good solid motherboard at a good price.
reviews.comment: Excellent no frills motherboard. Easy install and worked perfectly from start. Wanted to upgrade my computer to Windows 11 and this board was a perfect fit especially if you are not into intense gaming.

reviews.title: CAME IN FAULTY
reviews.comment: I ordered this and it came WITHOUT a box, WITHOUT a manual (I don't need one anyways but it would have been a good customer service gesture) and it was banging around in a flimsy box filled with paper on arrival. I checked its pins which were all in tact so I thought it survived but after completing my build, it didn't. It turned on originally and let me boot to Windows and as soon as I opened an application it froze and I powered it off but after that it wouldn't display. After checking and testing the rest of my parts I returned this mobo and got an MSI Pro mobo and after replacing it, my PC worked with no issues. I guarantee the way they shipped it was what caused its malfunction and I was only given partial refund back so I lost $20. I highly recommend not buying this as you will be disappointed one way or another.
reviews.author: Bruce H.
